description: Standard Library for the Base Node (.bn) language

math.name: math
math.description: Mathematical toolkit for Geometry Nodes: shaping curves, waves, vectors, SDFs, and noise distributions

sdf2d.name: sdf2d
sdf2d.description: 2D signed distance fields, boolean operations, and 2D primitive SDF shapes

curves2d.name: curves2d
curves2d.description: 2D curves, resampling, curvature analysis, and path operations

patterns2d.name: patterns2d
patterns2d.description: 2D procedural patterns, tilings, grids, radial arrays, and geometric motifs

planar2d.name: planar2d
planar2d.description: Planar map partitioning, intersection splitting, face extraction, and region boundaries

fillet2d.name: fillet2d
fillet2d.description: Fillets, chamfers, and bevels for 2D polygonal curves and corners

mask2d.name: mask2d
mask2d.description: Compositor masks drawn by signed distance fields: disk, box, polygon, star, outline, letterbox

merge.name: merge
merge.description: Compositor Merge operations on premultiplied images: Porter-Duff over, under, in, out, atop, xor, stencil, mask, and plus, minus, multiply, screen, divide, difference, hypot; premult, unpremult, keymix

grade.name: grade
grade.description: Compositor colour tools on premultiplied images: Nuke's Grade and ColorCorrect, saturation by Rec. 709, Rec. 2020 or ACEScg luma, hue shift, exposure in stops, soft clip, clamp, Cineon log2lin and lin2log

stmap.name: stmap
stmap.description: Compositor image remapping by STMaps after Nuke's STMap: the identity UV ramp, an STMap applied with its alpha as coverage, Tile with mirror, Mirror, Reformat to a size by fit, fill or distort, each as its STMap and its image

qc.name: qc
qc.description: Compositor quality control after Nuke: the test patterns of its image generators (SMPTE colour bars at 75 %, colour wheel, ramp, radial, rectangle, grid, checkerboard, constant) and the checks of an image (false colour by stops of luminance, clip check above 1 and below 0, NaN and infinity check, zebra, alpha over a checker, difference as heat)
